items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Appoints Darshan Kantak To Lead Global Ads Push
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS: NFLX) has appointed former Google executive Darshan Kantak as VP to lead its global ads platform. Kantak will oversee engineering, product, and data science for Netflix's advertising unit as the business scales out its ad offering. The hire comes as Netflix prepares to extend its ad supported tier into 15 additional countries in 2027.
